## Built for enterprise, secure by design
Build trust with the [[Basis framework] (https://docs.parallel.ai/task-api/guides/access-research-basis)](https://docs.parallel.ai/task-api/guides/access-research-basis) , unique to Parallel: calibrated confidence scores, citations, source excerpts, and reasoning traces.

## FAQs
For teams with stricter requirements, enterprise controls are available. See our terms of service for more information.
* **How do I connect Parallel to my agent or existing stack?**
You have a few options. Call the REST API directly, or use the Python (parallel-web) or TypeScript SDK.

...

On Parallel’s agentic APIs (Web Agents), every output supports [Basis](https://docs.parallel.ai/task-api/guides/access-research-basis) , our verifiability framework, which attaches citations, the reasoning behind a result, and a calibrated confidence score to each fact.

...

If you already use the OpenAI SDK, point your base URL at the Chat API and swap your key; everything else works the same. Parallel also integrates with LangChain, the Vercel AI SDK, and Google Vertex AI, and delivers async results over webhooks. Start at [docs.parallel.ai](https://docs.parallel.ai) .

data.content:
# AI Agent Parallel Processing Workflow
## My thoughts on the article."Multi-AI Agent: Parallel processing and automatic summarization using multiple LLMs."
Freeman](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-close-up-of-a-blue-wall-with-vertical-lines-cVGNBJJFNds)_

## **Link**
**[Multi-AI Agent: Parallel processing and automatic summarization using multiple LLMs](https://medium.com/@astropomeai/multi-ai-agent-parallel-processing-and-automatic-summarization-using-multiple-llms-ad80f410ae21)**

...

## **My thoughts**
The article sets up an example where LLMs are processed sequentially and then explains how to implement them so that they are run in a parallel process using LangGraph.
**[LangGraph](https://langchain-ai.github.io/langgraph/)** describes itself as:

...

In the example, they create the following structure:
* **Supervisor** to control the process and assign tasks to each AI Agent
* **AI Agent** to complete the assigned task and send the result to a summarizer
* **Summarizer** to get the results from all the AI Agents and generate a final output.

...

### **The Core Challenge when working with multiple LLMs**
For example, if each LLM call takes 2 seconds, three models would take 6+ seconds to complete.
But if we run them in parallel, it’ll take 2 seconds.

### **Their Solution Using LangGraph**
The article implements a graph-based solution with three components:
1. A supervisor to manage tasks
2. Multiple agents (one per LLM) running in parallel
3. A summarizer to combine results
